picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the Air Force flew an AI agent in autonomous control of an F-16, a concrete milestone toward scalable autonomous air combat and a bellwether for AI's expanding role in national defense systems.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's American Science Cloud gives the federal Genesis Mission a shared DOE infrastructure unifying data, models, and HPC resources, a foundational move that could accelerate AI-driven science across the entire national lab system.
picks.title: How the Genesis Mission’s American Science Cloud Advances Innovation

picks.editorial_note: UCSF Health's new accelerator with Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital embeds venture-backed AI startups directly inside a working academic hospital, a novel model for turning healthcare AI research into deployed clinical tools.
picks.title: UCSF Health Partners to Launch New Model to Build Healthcare AI

picks.editorial_note: A major alumnus gift launches Georgia Tech's Petit Center for AI-Driven Health Innovation, signaling continued large-scale philanthropic investment in AI-for-health research infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: WashU's BeaconPredict, an AI tool that predicts dangerous post-stroke brain swelling, earned FDA Breakthrough Device designation, marking real regulatory progress toward AI tools reaching patient bedsides.
picks.title: Tool to predict brain swelling earns FDA Breakthrough Device designation

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory convened UK government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven industrial strategy for aerospace, energy, and defense, reflecting AI's growing role in national competitiveness policy.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University signed an MoU with NVIDIA and launched the Chula AI Center, a significant industry-academia partnership expanding AI research and talent development in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: The National Academies' international workshop on AI-enabled biological threats addresses a pressing dual-use risk, shaping how policymakers approach biosecurity as AI tools lower barriers to biotechnology misuse.
picks.title: Strengthening Preparedness Against Novel Biological Threat Agents Enabled Through Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies

picks.editorial_note: A new UC Santa Barbara-LLNL collaboration is using AI to model extreme plasma physics relevant to nuclear fusion, connecting AI research directly to national energy and stockpile-stewardship science.
picks.title: Lab Report: July 17, 2026 | Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

picks.editorial_note: WashU's C-BRAIN consortium brings together academia, pharmaceutical companies, and other partners around a shared AI-driven research effort, illustrating the kind of broad multi-sector alliance increasingly needed to tackle major disease research.
